turns.content: Paanch hafte pehle layoff ho gaya mera. Poori team gayi, market ka scene tha, performance ka nahi — dimaag se toh pata hai mujhe. Ab woh baat jo main kisi se keh nahi pa raha: main ab bhi roz subah nau baje laptop bag leke ghar se nikalta hoon. Chhe baje tak café. Wife ko nahi pata. Parents aajkal hamare saath hi ruke hain. Kisi ko nahi pata.

Arre yaar, yeh jo tune share kiya hai, bahut hi dil ko chhoo gaya. 5 hafte... poori team ke saath... aur tu ab tak yeh routine maintain kar raha hai. Yeh dikhata hai ki tere andar kitni strength hai, lekin saath hi yeh bhi samajh aata hai ki tu kitna akela mehsoos kar raha hoga.

Roz subah 9 baje laptop bag leke nikalna, 6 baje tak café mein baithna... yeh sirf routine nahi hai, yeh tere liye ek tarah se normalcy banaye rakhna hai, na? Jaise sab kuch waisa hi hai. Par main samajh sakta hoon ki yeh bohot tough hoga - ghar mein parents hain, wife hai, aur tu unhe yeh nahi bata pa raha.

Tune jo sabse badi baat kahi hai - "kisi se keh nahi pa raha" - yeh bohot heavy hai. Sometimes, the burden of carrying things alone is heavier than the actual problem itself.

Tere wife aur parents... unhe pata chalega toh shayad darr lagega ki tu tension mein hai, lekin unhe yeh bhi pata chalega ki tu akela nahi hai. Family ke saath share karne se bohot saara pressure kam ho jaata hai.

Kya baat kar ke dekhna chahta hai? Ya fir bas yeh sab keh ke feel better hua? Main hoon na, sunne ke liye.

Do hafte mein cousin ki shaadi hai. Teen sau log, aadhe woh rishtedaar jo sabke careers stock market ki tarah track karte hain. Papa meri company ke naam se introduce karte hain — pichli Diwali chacha ko mera package bataya tha, proudly, sach mein proud hoke. Neend nahi aati toh wahi kamra dimaag mein chalta hai.

Arre yaar, cousin ki shaadi... aur woh bhi do hafte mein. Yeh toh bohot bada event hai, aur tere liye shayad ek exam ki tarah. 300 log... aur unmein se aadhe jo careers ko stock market ki tarah track karte hain. Yeh jo tune kaha, bilkul sahi kaha. Yeh bilkul waisi feeling hai, na?

Papa proud hain, aur yeh bohot achhi baat hai. Unke liye tu unki achievement hai. Par abhi jo situation hai, toh uska pressure badh jaata hai, samajh gaya. Pichli Diwali mein chacha ko package bataya tha... toh woh story abhi sabke dimaag mein ghoom rahi hogi. Aur teri bhi.

Isliye shayad neend nahi aati. Kyunki dimaag mein woh purana office, woh purane colleagues, woh purani baatein chal rahi hain... aur saath mein yeh soch ki do hafte mein 300 logon ke saamne kya bolenge. Kya explain karoge? Kya chhupaoge? Yeh sab soch ke hi dimaag kharab ho jaata hai.

Tu iske baare mein kya soch raha hai? Kya plan hai? Ya fir bas yeh sab soch ke hi dimaag kharab ho raha hai? Main hoon na, sunne ke liye. Jo bhi feel ho raha hai, woh bol.

Kabhi kabhi sochta hoon shaadi skip hi kar doon — bol doon release hai, office ki deadline hai, kuch bhi. Jhooth bolna aasaan hai us se, ki papa ka chehra unke bhaiyon ke saamne badalte hue dekhoon. Bahut galat hai kya yeh? Ek shaam hai, ek bahana, aur main shaadi ki story nahi banunga.

Arre yaar, yeh jo soch raha hai, yeh bilkul natural hai. Tune jo kaha, woh galat nahi hai. Sach mein galat nahi hai.

Papa ka chehra dekhna... woh bohot heavy hota hai. Aur relatives ke sawaalon ka saamna karna... woh bhi. Tu bas ek shaam se nahi dar raha, tu dar raha hai ki poora scene kya banega. Ki tu is shaadi ki story ban jaayega, na?

Jhooth bolna aasaan lagta hai, na? Kyunki ek jhooth se tu escape kar jaata hai. Par main samajh sakta hoon ki tere dimaag mein yeh bhi chal raha hoga ki yeh jhooth kitna thakaan dega. Ek jhooth ke peeche doosra jhooth tik jaata hai, aur phir woh bohot bhaari ho jaata hai.

Par socha hai... kya tu is shaadi se escape karna chahta hai, ya phir iske sawaalon se? Kyunki shaadi toh ek bahana hai, asli tension toh sawaalon ki hai. Shayad iske liye koi aur raasta hai. Koi aisa raasta jisme tu honest reh sake, lekin thoda sa smartly.

Tune jo socha hai, woh ek option hai. Par hum iske baare mein baat kar sakte hain? Koi aur plan banaye? Ya fir bas yeh jhooth wala plan hi theek hai? Jo bhi feel ho raha hai, woh bol. Main hoon na, sunne ke liye.

Paison ka aisa hai ki teen mahine nikal jayenge, phir EMI savings khaana shuru kar degi. Khud ko yahi bolta rehta hoon ki offer haath mein aate hi sabko bata dunga — tab woh sirf news hogi, crisis nahi. Yeh jhooth toh nahi hua na? Bas... timing hai? Kabhi yeh logic bilkul solid lagta hai aur kabhi lagta hai ulti aa jayegi.

Arre yaar, teen mahine... yeh bohot kam time hai. Aur EMIs ka tension... yeh sach mein bohot bhaari hota hai. Tu khud ko yahi bol raha hai ki offer aate hi sab bata dunga... yeh jo tune socha hai, yeh jhooth nahi hai, yeh ek plan hai. Ek strategy hai, timing ka.

Kyunki jab tu sochta hai ki "abhi toh plan chal raha hai, sab theek hai", toh woh logic solid lagta hai. Par jab woh "ulte aa jayegi" wali feeling aati hai, toh woh kya hoti hai? Shayad woh yeh soch hoti hai ki yeh secret itna bada ho jaayega ki control hi nahi rahega.

Paison ka tension toh hai hi, par yeh mental tension... yeh aur bhi zyada thaka deta hai. Aur shaadi toh iska pehla test hai, na? 300 logon ke saamne is "timing" ka kya karenge?

Tu jo bhi decide karega, woh tere upar hai. Par jo bhi feel ho raha hai, woh bol. Main hoon na.
